sentences.indigenousText: Kanarikay a mikilim, ano icowa:ay to?
sentences.chineseText: 趕快去找，不知到哪去了？

sentences.indigenousText: Matepa^ to. Hilam itira: i rarikor no ’ongcoy a milimek.
sentences.chineseText: 找到了！原來躲在大石頭的後面。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolah ko ’oner a masadak to dadaya^.
Maolah milimek ciira i so^metay ato i fokelokelohan.
sentences.chineseText: 牠喜歡躲在潮濕的地方和石頭堆裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano tomowa’ ho ko ngapa^ nira i, caay to kacaloway a milaliw ko ’edo ato takola^.
sentences.chineseText: 只要張開嘴，老鼠和青蛙都很難逃開。

sentences.indigenousText: Salo:ngan a nenengen ko ’adipapang.
Sa’ayaw i, o lalipana’ ho^ ciira.
sentences.chineseText: 原初，牠還是一隻毛毛蟲。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini^ i, cifodoy to ciira to cisapikpikay.
sentences.chineseText: 現在，牠穿著美麗的翼衣。

sentences.indigenousText: I hanahanaan to ciira a misaefeefer.
Na’onen! Tahaco^coa i ’arifateng.

lessons.title: Nawiro kahengang ko para’ no lotong?
lessons.titleCh: 猴子的屁股為什麼是紅色的？

sentences.indigenousText: Iti:ya ho, samsamen no lotong ko ’alem.
Sapipasadakan ciira toya ’alem, saka palamalen niira koya feso’.
sentences.chineseText: 牠想要逼穿山甲出來，就放火燒那洞穴。

sentences.indigenousText: Caay ka hiratera:teng, tata’ang tata:’ang to aca koya lamal.
Matodoh ko para’ no tireng.
Nanitiya, malakahengangay to ko para’ no lotong.
sentences.chineseText: 從那時候，猴子的屁股就變成紅色了。

lessons.title: Mafana’ kako a somowal to sowal no Pangcah

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ kiso a somowal to sowal no Pangcah haw?
Pangta^ ko nikafana’an ako, minanamay ho^ kako.
Icowa^ kiso a minanam to sowal no Pangcah?
I picodadan kako a minanam.
Rahoday a nanamen ko sowal no Pangcah haw?
Hay! Kakalipahakan ko pinanam.
Fa:ngcal ko pisanoPangcah no miso.
sentences.chineseText: 你說的阿美族語很流利。

sentences.indigenousText: O Yin-cu-min kamo haw?
Hay, o Yin-cu-min kami.
O Pariwan kamo haw?
Caay, o Pangcah kami.
O Pangcah ko sa’alomanay i niyaro’ niyam.
sentences.chineseText: 我們村子裡的人大多是阿美族。

sentences.indigenousText: Malopisak i sawalian ato i teloc no Taywan ko Pangcah.
sentences.chineseText: 我們阿美族分佈在台灣的東部和尾部（南部）。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafana’ ci akong a pakongko^.
Mararid kako a maro’ i lidong no kilang a mitengil to pipakongko^ ni akong.
sentences.chineseText: 我常常坐在樹下，聽阿公講故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mafa:na’ cingra a pakongko^ to kakaolahan a mitengil.
Ano o masamaamaanay to a kongko^ i, maolah kako a mitengil.
sentences.chineseText: 各類的故事，我都喜歡聽。

sentences.indigenousText: Soloten ako to lu-ku-ong-ki ko nipakongkoan ni akong.
sentences.chineseText: 我用錄音機錄下阿公講的故事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mapolong a mitengil kami o malakapotay a micodad.
Cima^ ko mikingkiway to dingwa^?
Icowa^ ko satakara:way a loma’?
O maan ko sakahanhan no foting?
Enaw mafotili’ ko kakarayan?
Icowa^ mikilim to ca’of?
I codad. Malalok a micodad i, matongal ko fana’ no mita.
sentences.chineseText: 在書裡。勤讀書可以讓我們增加知識。

sentences.indigenousText: Namiasip to kiso tina “Ilisin no ’Amis” sanay a codad haw?
sentences.chineseText: 你讀過《阿美族豐年祭》這本書嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Namiasip to kako. Kakahemekan kina codad.
Manga’ay caliwen ako kora codad haw?
sentences.chineseText: 那本書我可以向你借嗎？

sentences.indigenousText: Awaay ko no mako, nika ira ko ni Panay. Tanamay ako a somowal cingra.
sentences.chineseText: 我沒有，但是Panay有。我試試幫你向她傳話。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ira i, patorod hato kako haw. Aray!
sentences.chineseText: 如果有的話，就請你交給我。謝謝！

sentences.indigenousText: Hay! Ano maherek kiso a miasip, kanca^ panokas hato i ci Panayan.
sentences.chineseText: 好的，如果你讀完了，務必親自還給Panay。

sentences.indigenousText: Malahakelong kako ato kapot a tayra i picakayan to codad inacila^.
sentences.chineseText: 昨天我和同學一起到書店去。

sentences.indigenousText: Mangalay kami a micakay to ci-ting ato no kongko^ a codad.
sentences.chineseText: 我們都想買字典和故事書。

sentences.indigenousText: Hilam han o malecaday aca^ ko nicakayan niyam a ci-ting.
sentences.chineseText: 結果我們兩人各買了一本相同的字典。

sentences.indigenousText: Nikaorira, caay ka lecad ko nicakayan niyam to no kongko^ a codad.
sentences.chineseText: 但是，我們買的故事書卻不同。

sentences.indigenousText: O ni An-tu-sen ko nicakayan niira, o ni I-sop ko nicakayan ako.
sentences.chineseText: 他買的是《安徒生童話》，我買的是《伊索寓言》。

sentences.indigenousText: Talacowaan, caaca:ay ka lecad ko nicakayan niyam to codad, kirami lalecad saan ko ’aca^.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然買的書不同，但是價錢卻剛好相同。

sentences.indigenousText: Minanam kako a misorit to codad.
Mangalay kako tahenay a mafana’.
Ano mafana’ to kako a misorit i,
patikamien ako ko kaka^ ako.
I Tay-pak ciira a matayal, tadamaoron kako i ciiraan.
sentences.chineseText: 他在台北工作，我很想念他。

sentences.indigenousText: Masamaanay to ko ’orip naira hakiya?
sentences.chineseText: 不知道他們的生活過得怎麼樣呢？

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay ho^ ko miso kaka!
Lipahak ko faloco’ ako a pakalayap to tikami^ iso anini^.
sentences.chineseText: 今天接到你的信，我非常高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Maolah kako toya toloay a codad, o nipafelian iso i takowanan i ’ayaw nonini a folad.
sentences.chineseText: 我都很喜歡你上個月送給我的三本書。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipi-yi to, mamalasingsi^ to kiso saan ko sowal a matengil.
sentences.chineseText: 聽說你畢業了，就要當老師了。

sentences.indigenousText: O mamisa’icel kako a micodad.
Nanay matiya kiso, mamalafangcalay a singsi^ kako.
sentences.chineseText: 希望我像你一樣，將來做個優秀的老師。

sentences.indigenousText: Micodad kako to re-ci^ to romi’ami’ad.
Codaden ako ko malitemohay a demak to romi’ami’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 我把每天發生的事記下來。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano matira, manga’ay kako a minanam a misorit,
sentences.chineseText: 這樣不但可以練習寫字，

sentences.indigenousText: adihay ko mata’elifay to ako a demak i laloma’ no re-ci^.
sentences.chineseText: 日記裡有許多我過去的事。

sentences.indigenousText: O hahadimelen ako a mi’anang.
Cifodoy to kandaway ko yo-fing.
Saromi’ami’ad saan a patangasa^ to tikami^ to pilomaloma’.
sentences.chineseText: 每天挨家挨戶替人們送信。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano ma’orad to, ano macidal to ko romi’ad i,
hacecacecay han niira ko tikami^ a patangasa^ i pilomaloma’.
sentences.chineseText: 他把信一封一封送到各家各戶。

sentences.indigenousText: Lipahak ko tamdaw a pakalayap to tikami^.
sentences.chineseText: 人們收到了信，都很高興。

sentences.indigenousText: Raheker ko faloco’ noya yo-fing.
sentences.chineseText: 那郵差的心裡也感到很欣慰。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano citama’ ko Pangcah i, mipafatis to fiyaw.
sentences.chineseText: 如果阿美族族人去打獵有所捕獲，會把獵物分享給鄰居（親友）。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano cilafang ko Pangcah to naniraayay i, pasadak ko i loma’ay to kaeso’ay a kakaenen.
sentences.chineseText: 如果阿美族有朋友自遠方來，家的主人會端出美食出來宴客。

sentences.indigenousText: I kailisinan sato i, nisatoron, mipacok to fafoy, ato pasadak to eraw.
sentences.chineseText: 在部落舉行祭典時，他們舂打粢粑，殺豬，以及擺出釀造的小米酒。

sentences.indigenousText: O rayray no tato’asan no Pangcah konini.
Sowal sa ko mato’asay, “Ano masoni^ ko rakorako^ i, o mama’orad; ano masoni^ ko fanol i, o mamacidal.” saan ko sowal.
sentences.chineseText: 老人常說：「樹蛙鳴必降雨，鴿子啼必天晴。」

sentences.indigenousText: O imi^ nonini a sowal i,
ano matengil ko nikasoni^ no rakorako^ to dadaya^ i, caay ka eca^ mama’orad to cila^.
sentences.chineseText: 如果夜裡聽見樹蛙叫的聲音，那麼隔天一定會下雨。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano tipokoy sa ko fanol to dafak i, caay ka eca^ fangcalay koya romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 如果早晨聽見鴿子的鳴啼聲，當天必定是好天氣。

sentences.indigenousText: O manina’ay no to’as i ’orip nangra kora.
sentences.chineseText: 那是袓先他們經驗過的生活。

sentences.indigenousText: Latek ira: ko caayay kalaheci^, nikaorira, o so’elinay kora.
sentences.chineseText: 雖然不一定準確，不過那是事實。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasifana’ ko singsi niyam a misanga’ to tiftif anini^ a romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 今天老師教我們製作口簧琴。

sentences.indigenousText: O maan ko tiftif?
O nisanga’an no mato’asay ita to sasonian, o tekes ko sapisanga’.
sentences.chineseText: 它是我們祖先發明的樂器，是用桂竹做成的。

sentences.indigenousText: O hacowa^ ko sapisoni^ to tiftif?
sentences.chineseText: 什麼時侯可以吹口簧琴？

sentences.indigenousText: Itini i kasa^sa’an no mawmahay.
Kirami, ano citelep ko loma’ i, tatiih a misoni^; nawhani, paysin.
sentences.chineseText: 但是，如果家裡有人去世，就不能吹奏，因為會觸犯禁忌。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko loma’, o ’ariri^ ato pikacawan no niyaro’ ita.
sentences.chineseText: 我們的部落有房舍、穀倉和瞭望台。

sentences.indigenousText: O pikisaemelan ato pikidihekoan ko loma’ ita.
sentences.chineseText: 家屋是讓我們乘涼和取暖的地方。

sentences.indigenousText: O pi’anangan to kinaira ko ’ariri^, o sakacaaw ka kaen no ’edo^.
sentences.chineseText: 穀倉用來存放農作物，防止老鼠偷吃到。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira i sacomod no niyaro’ ko pikacawan, o pikecoran a minengneng to rakat no ’ada^.
sentences.chineseText: 瞭望台在部落的入口，用來觀察敵人的行動。

sentences.indigenousText: O nanoto’as ita o Pangcah a pinasanga’ kiraan.
sentences.chineseText: 那是我們阿美族的傳統建築。

sentences.indigenousText: Oya ma’araway a niyaro’ i, o Pos-ko^.
sentences.chineseText: 那看得見的部落是玉里。

sentences.indigenousText: Ira ko patiyamay, o yo-fing ato pipaisingan itira.
sentences.chineseText: 那裡有商店、郵局和醫院。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay kita a talapatiyamay a micakay to maamaan.
sentences.chineseText: 我們可以到商店買東西。

sentences.indigenousText: Nga’ay kita a tala-yo-fing a micu-king, miepod to pida^ ato paefer to tikami^.
sentences.chineseText: 也可以到郵局存錢、領錢和寄信。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano adada^ i, manga’ay a talapipaisingan a paising.
sentences.chineseText: 如果生病了，可以到醫院看病。

sentences.indigenousText: Inian a kalopitokohan i, o sakacaloway no mita a ma’orip.
sentences.chineseText: 這些現代的設施讓我們的生活方便。

sentences.indigenousText: Tosa^ a pa-sin-to^ no po:long no tamdaw i Tay-wan ko Yin-cu-min.
sentences.chineseText: 原住民的人口佔台灣總人口的2%。

sentences.indigenousText: Maedeng o kalitosa^ noya tamdaw ko i niyaro’ay.
sentences.chineseText: 大約有一半的人在部落裡。

sentences.indigenousText: O roma^ a kalitosa^ i, i to-kay to a maro’.
sentences.chineseText: 另一半的人住在都市裡了。

sentences.indigenousText: Adihay ko katayalan i to-kay saka, masolot ko kapah ato kay^ing.
sentences.chineseText: 都市的工作機會多，所以吸引男女青年。

sentences.indigenousText: I to-kay to caira a matayal ato misaparod.
sentences.chineseText: 他們已在都市成家，工作也在那裡。

sentences.indigenousText: Orasaka, o teloc no Yin-cu-min, ’aloman to ko i to-kayay a mato’as anini^.
sentences.chineseText: 所以，現在有許多的原住民的後代在都市長大。

sentences.indigenousText: Miilisin ko niyaro’ niyam i salaloma’ no faloay ato siwaay a folad to mihecahecaan.
sentences.chineseText: 每年的八月到九月之間，我們的部落舉行「豐年祭」。

sentences.indigenousText: O satadamaanay no niyaro’ ato o kasa’opoan haca^ no kasangasaw koya romi’ad.
sentences.chineseText: 那是部落非常重要的日子，也是每個家族團聚的時刻。

sentences.indigenousText: Mapolong ko ’alomanay a romadiw ato masakero^ i papotal, malipahak to nikasefek no kinaira no pinaloma^.
sentences.chineseText: 大家在廣場上快樂地唱歌和跳舞來慶祝豐收。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini^ a mihecaan, paka-hi-ko-ki^ a taloma’ naniTay-pak ko po:long no paro^ no loma’ no faki^ ako.
sentences.chineseText: 今年，叔叔一家人從台北搭飛機回來。

sentences.indigenousText: Pasowal ko kaka^ ako, ‘‘O ilisin no niyaro’ ko kakaoronan niyam i Tay-pak.’’ saan.
sentences.chineseText: 我哥哥說：「我們在台北最懷念的，就是家鄉的豐年祭。」

sentences.indigenousText: Sarikoray to a kasakeroan a romi’ad no ilisin anini^.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是豐年祭歌舞節目的最後一天。

sentences.indigenousText: O pakomod hananay a demak haw i, macakat i tongroh no loma’ no kakitaan ko pacihakay a mifosfos to eraw. Nanay masaray ko kaloadada^ no tamdaw o saanay.
sentences.chineseText: 所謂的pakomod儀式是，女祭司爬上宗祠的屋頂，向大眾撒甜酒。以示驅邪並治好大眾的各種疾病。

sentences.indigenousText: O pakeras haw i, miliyaw a macakat ko pacihakay a mifolesak to nisangicingiciwan a ’icep. Nanay citama’ ko kapah a mi’adop ato mifoting o saanay.
sentences.chineseText: 至於pakeras儀式是，女祭司再次爬到宗祠的屋頂上，向大眾撒檳榔切片。以示祝福部落青年上山打獵、下海漁撈順遂，常有獵獲。

sentences.indigenousText: Anini^ palimo^ han to a palacecay ko pakomod ato pakeras.
sentences.chineseText: 今天把pakomod和pakeras 合併成為palimo^。

sentences.indigenousText: O paramod han no Pangcah ko patatawos to tatosaay.
sentences.chineseText: 阿美族人把兩人結為伴侶視為結婚的意思。

sentences.indigenousText: Ano cimaramoday i niyaro’ i, o tata’angay a demak no ngangasawan.
sentences.chineseText: 部落裡有人結婚，是整個氏族的大事。

sentences.indigenousText: Mipatala^ to siraw ato eraw ko loma’ no caciramod no malaynaay.
sentences.chineseText: 結婚者家裡會準備鹹豬肉和糯米酒宴請親友。

sentences.indigenousText: Masasipafeli^ to sapatapang ko mararamoday.
sentences.chineseText: 結婚夫妻要交換定情物。

sentences.indigenousText: Mikitemel ko faki^ a somowal, mipalemed ko finawlan i cairaan.
sentences.chineseText: 伯父輩會給他們訓話，族人會給他們祝福。

sentences.indigenousText: O pico^yapan no niyam a romi’ad anini^.
sentences.chineseText: 今天是我們畢業的日子。

sentences.indigenousText: Atien no picodadan ko kalas no niyaro’ a mikerid to pisaselal.
sentences.chineseText: 學校請耆老為我們舉辦成年禮。

sentences.indigenousText: Papilifeten nangra kami a mipana’.
Maparenget ko pakalifetay a micodaday.
sentences.chineseText: 通過的學生才能戴上頭飾。

sentences.indigenousText: Mitolon ko mato’asay, mikitemel a pa’icel i tamiyanan to sakalalok a matayal.
sentences.chineseText: 長老祈福，並且勉勵我們做事要認真。

sentences.indigenousText: Yo matengil to ko piparadiw i, madado^do kami a masadak naipicodadan, misi’ayaw to faelohay a ’orip.
sentences.chineseText: 當聽到歌聲響起，我們一個接一個走出學校，邁向新的人生。
